# Preferred Recruit Track & Field Standards

> College track and field recruiting standards, results and rankings for every program: NCAA Division I, II, III and NAIA. Target, Recruit and Walk-On marks for {{SCHOOLS}} colleges (134 from the schools' own verified published standards), national top marks and national champions from 2016 to today, and a recruiting chat that answers from this data.

## Key pages

- [Home and standards search](https://trackandfieldstandards.com/): enter an event and personal best (high school 1600m, 3200m and 300m hurdles are converted) to see every college it fits.
- [Explore](https://trackandfieldstandards.com/explore.html): every conference, state, event standard, national champion and top-marks list.
- School pages: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/schools/<school-name>-track-standards (e.g. /schools/university-of-oregon-track-standards)
- Conference pages: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/conferences/<conference>-track-standards.html (e.g. /conferences/sec-track-standards.html)
- Division overviews (median Target, Recruit and Walk-On mark in every event): https://trackandfieldstandards.com/standards/ncaa-d1-track-and-field-recruiting-standards.html , /standards/ncaa-d2-track-and-field-recruiting-standards.html , /standards/ncaa-d3-track-and-field-recruiting-standards.html , /standards/naia-track-and-field-recruiting-standards.html
- Standards by division and event: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/standards/<division>-<mens|womens>-<event>.html (e.g. /standards/ncaa-d1-mens-400m.html)
- States: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/states/<state>-college-track-and-field.html
- National champions: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/champions/<year>-<outdoor|indoor>-<division>.html
- Top marks: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/results/<year>-<season>-<division>-<mens|womens>-<event>.html
- [Sitemap](https://trackandfieldstandards.com/sitemap.xml)

## How the standards work

- Target: marks that typically earn the strongest scholarship interest, depending on school funding.
- Recruit: where coaches typically start recruiting conversations and scholarship discussions. Not a guarantee.
- No athletic scholarships: Ivy League schools (Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Dartmouth, Harvard, Penn, Princeton, Yale) and every NCAA Division III school give no athletic scholarships; their aid is need-based or academic. At those schools the levels show what it takes to make the team, not athletic money.
- Walk-On: the minimum mark to earn a roster spot.
- Schools marked official publish their own standards (2024 or newer, verified mark for mark). Others are set from that conference's 2026 results: NCAA D1/D2 Target = 8th, Recruit = 15th, Walk-On = 25th best mark; NCAA D3/NAIA Target = top 8, Walk-On = 40th.
- Results come from TFRRS performance lists and national championship meet results, refreshed every Monday.

## For high school athletes, parents and coaches
- How fast do you need to run in college, every high school event (100m to 3200m, hurdles, jumps, throws), by division: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/how-fast.html
- College cross country recruiting times by division (high school 5K and college 8K/10K/6K, D1 to NAIA): https://trackandfieldstandards.com/guides/college-cross-country-recruiting-times.html
- Best colleges for track and field 2026, ranked by athletes in the top 50 of each national outdoor list (D1, D2, D3, NAIA): https://trackandfieldstandards.com/guides/best-colleges-for-track-and-field.html
- Printable one-page recruiting standards sheet (PDF): https://trackandfieldstandards.com/track-and-field-recruiting-standards-2026.pdf
- "What colleges can I run for with a [mark]?" pages, e.g. https://trackandfieldstandards.com/colleges-for/mens-1600m-4-30.html
- High school to college conversions (1600m to 1500m, 3200m to 3000m/5000m, 300m to 400m hurdles, 39-inch to 42-inch hurdles): https://trackandfieldstandards.com/convert.html
- Target, Recruit and Walk-On explained: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/guides/target-recruit-walk-on-explained.html
- NCAA D1 vs D2 vs D3 vs NAIA compared: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/guides/ncaa-d1-vs-d2-vs-d3-vs-naia-track-and-field.html
- Junior college (NJCAA) track and field recruiting, programs by state and national results: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/guides/junior-college-track-and-field-recruiting.html (junior colleges have results, not predicted levels)
- For parents: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/for-parents.html
- Free embeddable standards finder for high school and club coaches: https://trackandfieldstandards.com/for-coaches.html
